**1. Shared macro → this sector.** Risk-on helps XLC **only if mega-cap growth participates**. The dominant overlay is the **Hormuz/US-Iran oil supply shock** (WTI near $95, near $100) — but this is **day 2–3 continuation**, not a fresh kinetic increment. Per 09-08, when NQ outperforms ES on a risk-off day, XLC's mega-cap growth core is relatively defended. On 09-08 NQ was −0.16% vs ES −0.44% (28bp gap) and XLC outperformed SPY (+0.09% rel). Today oil is up again but futures are **little changed** — the risk-off impulse is not intensifying into a fresh crash.

**CPI is due tomorrow (09-11)** — the load-bearing two-sided binary. Per the **09-04 asymmetric-downside lesson**: with a hawkish Fed backdrop (hot NFP, hike odds elevated) and a duration-heavy book, the hot-print branch is more probable AND more damaging. But that lesson fires **into the print day**, not the day before. Today is a pre-CPI positioning day with oil elevated. Real yields remain elevated (carried, not a fresh crush). Oil up + hawkish Fed + CPI tomorrow = **mild negative S0**, not severe. **S0 = −1** (oil shock + hawkish backdrop + pre-CPI caution), but capped because NQ/ES divergence suggests mega-cap growth is relatively defended and futures are little changed (not a fresh crash).

**2. Spine (mandatory).** Digital-ad recovery and AI monetization **proof** remain **one** carried thesis (eMarketer 2026 Meta ads ~$243.5B vs Google ~$239.5B; Meta Q2 ads ~$59.4B +27% / Advantage+ ~$60B run-rate; Alphabet Search/YouTube/Cloud). **Meta is up ~4.6% today** on the youth-safety deal clearing legal overhang (per stockstotrade) — this is a **fresh positive catalyst** for the top holding, a legal-overhang relief that is NOT yet in yesterday's tape (XLC was −0.46% on 09-08). This is the offset that the 08-17/08-18 legal lesson requires: a top-holding legal catalyst resolving positively with no offsetting negative on the other leader. **S1 = +1** on the Meta youth-safety overhang clearing + carried ad/AI thesis.

**3. Secondary.** Engagement/MAU with monetization: checked, nothing material. Antitrust **relief**: Meta youth-safety settlement clearing is the fresh positive (child-safety, not Alphabet remedy, but it removes a Meta overhang). Telecom ARPU/subscriber: AMX upgrade is not an XLC driver. Engagement deceleration: AppLovin PT cut is ad-tech adjacent, not META/GOOGL. Telecom price war: nothing material. Rotation: 1m rel +0.62% is modest, not extreme.

**4. Breadth / leadership.** MAP HEAT: **Internet Content & Information dir=flat** (GOOGL/GOOG pos, AI narrative intact but tape soft); **Entertainment dir=down** (NFLX −5.4% today on rate fears, DIS soft); **Electronic Gaming flat**; **Telecom flat** (resilient vs parent). Meta +4.6% is the single-name leader; GOOGL roughly flat (−0.03%). This is **not** broad sector breadth expansion — it is a Meta-led bounce with Alphabet flat. Per 09-08, do not score S2 negative on the macro inference when NQ/ES divergence suggests mega-cap growth is relatively defended. **S2 = 0** (mixed: Meta strong, GOOGL flat, NFLX weak — no clean breadth signal either way).

**5. Flows / positioning.** ETFdb: XLC 5d ~−$34M, 1m ~−$327M, 3m ~−$1.9B (trailing). Per 08-28/inverse 08-11, trailing unit outflows are **not** a 1-day lid. Crowding is mega-cap + unresolved capex, not an extreme 1d relative spike (1d rel −0.02%, 1m +0.62%). **S3 = 0**.

**6. Earnings / policy.** No fresh META/GOOGL/NFLX print. **CPI is tomorrow 09-11** — the load-bearing binary. Meta youth-safety deal clearing is the fresh catalyst. Oil shock is day-2 continuation.

## Lessons / audit
